def getAlertGroups(paramsDict):
		"""
			Returns alert groups (kanoaQDS)
			Args:
				paramsDict (dict) i.e {'alertGroupName' : 'Quality'}
				- enabled (bool)
				- alertGroupId (int)
				- alertGroupName (string)
			Returns:
				data: pyDataset
			
			Updated:
				JFC - 12/24/23: Refactored
				JFC - 11/20/24 9:17am: Pointed to view and added createdByUser, changedByUser
		"""
		
		dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('QDS')
		queryStr = []
		if paramsDict.has_key('enabled') and paramsDict['enabled'] is not None: queryStr.append("AND [enabled] = %d"%paramsDict['enabled'])	
		if paramsDict.has_key('alertGroupName') and paramsDict['alertGroupName'] is not None: queryStr.append("AND [alertGroupName] = '%s'"%paramsDict['alertGroupName'])	
		if paramsDict.has_key('alertGroupId') and paramsDict['alertGroupId'] is not None: queryStr.append("AND [alertGroupId] = %i"%paramsDict['alertGroupId'])	
		
		query = """
					SELECT 
						[alertGroupId]
						,[alertGroupName]
						,[emailList]
						,[enabled]
						,[createdBy]
						,[createdByUser]
						,[createdDate]
						,[changedBy]
						,[changedByUser]
						,[changedDate]
					FROM [qds].[vwAlertGroup]
					WHERE 1=1
					%s
					ORDER BY [alertGroupName]
				"""%('\n'.join(queryStr))
		
		return system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [], dbName)

	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(getAlertGroups({}))
